A bold wrapper holding only a newline-only span still separates the words on either side

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown-wasm";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<b>Alpha</b><b><span>\n</span></b><b>Beta</b>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
